sources.title: Transparent local calculations and prospective decision rules
sources.details: Time: (1000+200+400)/2=1300 ms and (2000+200+400)/2=2300 ms; equivalently offset+300. Relative to 2000-ms switch they lie 700/300 ms away. 3200/16000*1000=200 ms; 4000/250=16 frames at 0..3750; 16 mel features+1 energy=17. Convolution Hout=floor((Hin+2p-(k-1)-1)/stride+1); k3,p1,s1 gives Hout=Hin. The second layer takes 4*3*3=36 terms per output. Pooling 2x2 reduces32 to16, final global average has16*16=256 values per channel. (1+2+5+6)/4=3.5; total1..16=136, mean8.5; replace16 with32 adds16, right-bottom pool13.5+16/4=17.5, overall8.5+16/16=9.5. Sequence: 16 frames+4 audio+5 markers=25; event audio index1 is19+1=20; readout24. Planned thresholds:170/200=.85; ceil(.75*50)=38;37/50=.74 fails,38/50=.76 passes;180/200=.90;2 representations*3 seeds=6 downstream fits. A >5-percentage-point drop means100*(p_old-p_new)>5, not5% relative; e.g .80 to.75 exactly5pp does not exceed5, .80 to.749 does. These arithmetic facts do not certify trained quality or a statistical power target.
